thingsToDo.title: Sombrero Beach
thingsToDo.description: Use the city's public beach for swimming, picnicking, and a simple introduction to the Middle Keys shoreline.

thingsToDo.title: Old Seven Mile Bridge and Pigeon Key
thingsToDo.description: Walk or bike the restored bridge section toward historic Pigeon Key for railroad-era history and expansive water views.

thingsToDo.title: The Turtle Hospital
thingsToDo.description: Learn about sea-turtle rescue and rehabilitation through scheduled educational programs.

thingsToDo.title: Crane Point
thingsToDo.description: Explore hardwood hammock, nature trails, and local history within a preserved natural area in Marathon.

thingsToDo.title: Snorkeling and reef trips
thingsToDo.description: Book a reef excursion to experience the offshore marine environment that defines much of the Florida Keys.

thingsToDo.title: Bahia Honda State Park — separate park
thingsToDo.description: Drive west to this separately managed state park for beaches, bridge views, and clear-water recreation without treating it as Marathon municipal land.

bestTimeToVisit.title: Cooler months are easiest for outdoor planning
bullets: Late fall through early spring generally brings lower humidity and comfortable outdoor conditions.
Summer is hot, humid, and storm-prone; start exposed activities early and keep afternoon plans flexible.
Busy winter and holiday periods reward advance reservations for popular tours and timed attractions.

travelTips: Group each day by geography instead of crossing the region repeatedly.
Use early mornings for exposed outdoor activities and waterfront time.
Check park, marine, and weather conditions before nature-focused plans.
Treat nearby municipalities and protected areas as separate destinations with their own access rules.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Marathon?
faq.a: Two to three days is a good starting point for the core sights plus one outdoor or regional experience.

faq.q: Is Marathon good for outdoor travelers?
faq.a: Yes. The strongest itineraries combine the destination itself with nearby water, parks, preserves, or trails.
It depends on the destination, but a car or guided tour is often useful for protected lands and regional excursions.

faq.q: Should I book tours in advance?
faq.a: For high-demand wildlife, boating, park, and holiday-period experiences, advance booking is sensible.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Marathon is an incorporated Middle Keys city spread across several islands along the Overseas Highway.

sections.heading: Geography & setting
paragraphs: The city sits between Florida Bay and the Atlantic, with bridges and channels making water as important as land routes.

sections.heading: History & culture
paragraphs: Railroad, fishing, boating, and marine-conservation stories shape local culture.

sections.heading: Outdoor & seasonal highlights
paragraphs: Snorkeling, fishing, paddling, beach time, and bridge walks are natural anchors for outdoor visitors.

sections.heading: Getting around
paragraphs: A car is useful for island-hopping, while boat trips are essential for reefs and offshore experiences.
